prompt: Hello! The new puppy has eaten two phone chargers this week, so I am living dangerously. My train goes at 07:22, the walk to the station takes me 18 minutes and I want to get a ticket from the machine first, which usually takes 9 minutes, and I like a 15-minute buffer on the platform. What time should I get up and leave the house (HH:MM, 24-hour)? That is all from me, back to the laundry.

Hey you! My neighbour keeps leaving parcels on my porch, which is honestly very kind of him. the roast went into the oven at 15:38 and needs 85 minutes, then it has to rest for 20 minutes before carving. What time can we sit down to eat (HH:MM) if we carve the moment the rest is over? Cheers, and happy Friday if it is Friday where you are.

Hello! I tried sourdough agian and it came out like a very dense frisbee. my phone is at 75% and it loses about 8 percentage points an hour when I'm using it for maps. If I use it like that for 2 hours, what percentage will be left (just the number)?  Anyway, how are you doing?

hi. Our team lunch got moved agian and i think i am the only one who minds. dinner was $126.50 before the tip, there were 5 of us, and we want to leave 10%. If everyone rounds thier share up to the next whole dollar, how much does each person put in (just the dollar amount, like 27.00)? (Also my birthday is on the 14th, irrelevant here.) Hope your day is calmer than mine.

Hi! I just got back from a walk and my shoes are soaked, so I am typing with my feet up. we're painting the spare room: 5 m by 6 m with 2.4 m ceilings. Four walls only, and the door and windows add up to 5 m2 that we won't paint. The paint says 1 litre covers 10 m2 and I want 2 coats, and it comes in 5-litre tins. How many tins do I need to buy (a whole number)? (I have 2 spare notebooks nearby if that changes anything, which it probably doesn't.) That is all from me, back to the laundry.

Hi! We finally got the squeaky back door fixed, which felt like a major life achievement. My step goal is 8000 and I'm at 3100 right now, which is 14:00. If I keep a steady 1500 steps an hour, what time (HH:MM, rounding up to the next whole minute) do I hit the goal? And how many steps are left? Oh, and the cat says hello.
(Plain digits please, no thousands separators.)

Hi! Our team lunch got moved again and I think I am the only one who minds. I started learning the ukulele and the cat has statred leaving the room whenever I practise. we're splitting rent of $2,550.00 between Tariq, Konrad and Priya in proportion to room size: Tariq has 12 m2, Konrad has 15 m2, Priya has 20 m2. What does Konrad pay (nearest cent)? No pressure, I am in no particular hurry.

Hi there! The new puppy has eaten two phone chargers this week, so I am living dangerously. Work has been a bit of a blur since the reorgnaisation, but the coffee machine survived. for my pour-over I use 1 gram of coffee per 17 ml of water. I'm making 900 ml today. How many grams of coffee is that (one decimal), and how many 10 g scoops (one decimal)? No pressure, I am in no particular hurry.

Hello! The tomatoes on the balcony are finally turning red, I am unreasonably proud of them. I'm away for 10 weeks and my 7 plants each need 200 ml of water per week. How many litres is that altogether (one decimal if needed), and how many 1.5-litre bottles do I need to fill (whole bottles)? Oh, and the cat says hello.

Hi! We finally got the squeaky back door fixed, which felt like a major life achievement. the library charges 25 cents a day for each overdue book but never more than $8.00 per book. I have 3 books overdue by 34, 14, 7 days respectively. What is my total fine in dollars and cents? (I have 2 spare notebooks nearby if that changes anything, which it probably doesn't.) Hope your day is calmer than mine.
